label: FLUX.2 Klein 9B base + 360 ERP outpaint (a location's 360)

capabilities._note: One job: a location's 360 panorama (h3refs.plan_pano, engine klein). Its one reference is the plate placed on a green 2:1 canvas (comfy_nodes/h3_erp.py); the LoRA fills the green. `pano` mode keeps it out of the refs, keyframe and edit pickers.

template._note: The output is the canvas's size (the KSampler samples the encoded canvas), 2:1.

binding._note: nomadoor's own workflow (flux-2-klein-9B-360-erp-outpaint.json, on the LoRA's Hugging Face page) as an API graph, with PanoramaStickers replaced by a LoadImage of the canvas h3_erp.py makes and PanoramaCutout/Preview left out: the canvas is VAE-encoded and read both as a ReferenceLatent on the positive and negative and as the sampler's latent; KSampler euler/simple, 20 steps, cfg 5; a real negative prompt. Running the same LoRA through flux2_klein_edit's graph (Flux2Scheduler, the reference scaled to 1 MP, an empty latent, a zeroed negative) gave an over-cooked green field, so this graph is kept as the author ships it. H3SaveRefTake takes the place of SaveImage.

models._note: The BASE Klein 9B: the LoRA was trained on it, and its author says the distilled model draws it badly.

presets._note: The author's workflow: 20 steps, cfg 5, euler/simple, LoRA 0.9 (in the graph), negative 'text, worst quality, blurry, ugly'.

downloads._note: Where to get each file this target names (docs/API.md 'Downloads').

flux-2-klein-base-9b-fp8.safetensors.source: saved workflow image_flux2_klein_image_edit_9b_base.json (properties.models); also the LoRA author's workflow
